title: Elementary expansion for Grothendieck infinity-groupoids
exact_target: For every Grothendieck coherator C, every cellular C-infinity-groupoid X and every n-cell $a:D_n\to X$, is $X\to X\cup _{D_n}D_{n+1}$, attached along the source inclusion of the next globe, a weak equivalence?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis via elementary expansions
